title: Data Engineer
subtitle: Build the pipelines, warehouses and platforms every AI and analytics team depends on
summary: Move, model, clean and serve data reliably at scale - for analytics and for AI.
expert: Designs data platforms that are correct, fast, cheap and trusted: models data so the business can answer real questions, runs batch and streaming pipelines that recover on their own, understands storage and query engines from the inside, and feeds analytics and AI systems with data people can rely on.

benchmarks.title: Certification
benchmarks.detail: One cloud data-engineering certification: Microsoft Fabric Data Engineer (DP-700), AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or Google Professional Data Engineer.

benchmarks.title: SQL
benchmarks.detail: LeetCode SQL 50 study plan plus 100 further SQL problems, including 30 hard, each with a written explanation.

benchmarks.title: Peer-reviewed project
benchmarks.detail: A DataTalksClub Data Engineering Zoomcamp project passed through its public peer review.

benchmarks.title: Scale
benchmarks.detail: A pipeline that processes the full NYC TLC taxi trip dataset (over a billion rows) with documented run time and cost.

benchmarks.title: Defended out loud
benchmarks.detail: Defend your capstone platform for 30 minutes: data model, failure recovery, data quality, cost at 10x volume.
